text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, where the Umamusume who defined this year gather!
A massive crowd has packed the venue to witness this dream showdown!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Expectations are running especially high for them this year! The "Monster" Narita Brian and the "Empress" Hishi Amazon are ready to clash!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Seems like they're making quite a fuss about it.
choice_data_list: After all, it's the last Grand Prix of the year.
It's the last Grand Prix of the year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...The last one this year, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(When I first entered this world,
I was clutching at straws.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(I want to run more, I want to chase more.
Pleading for something to satisfy my heart—)

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: ……Let's run one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... You're just way too strong...
I hate you, I hate you so much~...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No waay... Aah,
even if I tried my hardest, I wouldn't stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I-Impossible. Running alongside someone like that.
I'm... scared...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Every time, I heard my heart drying up.
It felt like a piece of me was being chipped away.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Still, even so, the words my big sis said back then
remained in the back of my mind.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come to Tracen Academy.
There, you can run in real races.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps your thirst can be quenched as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And when I met her, she said,
"Once you debut, you'll find tons of opponents."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And when I met him, he said,
"Once you debut, you'll find tons of opponents."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: They might have been words spoken without any deep thought. But the days since debuting with her, with Trainerâ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian, step outside!
One lap around the turf course—it's a 1-on-1 showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. I've never
felt a sensation like this in my entire life.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Why did you introduce me to such a thing?!
Now I'm completely hooked...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text:
...I will definitely win...!
No matter who I'm up against... I will...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna climb even higher.
The next time I race you... I won't lose."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Then "when the time comes".

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ever since meeting her, my days have, to some extent...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, Narita Brian
has finally entered the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Everyone, please welcome them with a round of applause!
